label: Stage {number}

beginning.name: Just beginning
beginning.short: Your first weeks: wudu, learning to pray, what you now believe.
beginning.long: For the first weeks and months after your shahada. You will learn to make wudu, pray step by step, and understand the core of what you now believe.

foundations.name: Building the basics
foundations.short: Steady prayer, daily life, halal and haram.
foundations.long: For when the first steps feel familiar. You will make prayer a steady habit, learn a few short surahs, and handle everyday questions about food, family, and work.

deeper.name: Growing deeper
deeper.short: The Quran, the Prophet's life, the companions.
deeper.long: For when the basics are part of your life. You will go deeper into the Quran, the life of the Prophet, peace be upon him, and the people around him.

preparing: Paths for this stage are being prepared.
